title: Al-Serif – Company Website & Brochure
tagline: Clear brand storytelling and conversion-focused pages
intro: Launched a responsive brochure site for Al-Serif with a focus on services and case studies.
summary: Designed and developed using a lightweight React + Vite front-end and static hosting for cost-efficiency and performance.
